source_behavior.behavior: NewTemplateClicked delegates to NewTemplate. The source handler clears the selected key, enters new-template state, clears editable prompt fields, enables the draft, clears revision history and clears transient message state.
source_behavior.request_contract: The canonical click handler performs no backend request. Persistence belongs to the separate Save operation and is intentionally not absorbed by this one-operation closure.

laravel_adaptation.visible_binding: The AI Prompt Templates page renders a type=button New template control with the exact canonical operation marker and aria-controls binding to a hidden blank draft editor.
laravel_adaptation.state_transition: Clicking New template clears key/title/system/user draft values, restores Enabled=true, hides prior transient success/error feedback, reveals the blank new-template editor, reports truthful unsaved state and focuses the key field.
laravel_adaptation.truthfulness: The browser handler makes no fetch/XHR/form-submit/navigation call and reports that nothing has been persisted. It cannot fabricate save success or a revision.
laravel_adaptation.repeatability: Repeated clicks deterministically discard unsaved draft edits and restore the same blank new-template state.

security_and_tenancy.route_context: The control is only rendered after the existing tenant-qualified prompt-template route authorizes settings.manage and confirms the active TenantContext slug matches the route tenant.
security_and_tenancy.tenant_isolation_proof: Focused acceptance covers an authorized Tenant A manager attempting the foreign tenant route and receiving 404.
security_and_tenancy.guest_semantics: Guest GET redirects to login before the control is rendered.
security_and_tenancy.missing_permission_semantics: Authenticated tenant member without settings.manage receives 403 before the control is rendered.

acceptance_tests: frontend: resets the editor into a truthful blank new-template state without network activity
frontend: can be invoked repeatedly and clears draft edits every time

ci.evidence_bearing_head_rule: This file update creates a later evidence-bearing commit. That later commit must independently pass all exact-head repository workflows before final worker handoff.

evidence_commit_rule: A Git commit cannot embed its own SHA. The evidence-bearing commit that adds the green implementation CI metadata must itself pass all exact-head repository gates before final handoff/integration readiness is claimed.
